Custom Classic - Custom at no extra charge
Whether you're looking to travel, gravel grind, race, or just enjoy your tandem on weekend rides, a Rodriguez Tandem is the perfect choice. Every one we build is custom at no extra charge, so the fit is perfect every time. Have your tandem built by a team with years of tandem innovations and custom building experience.
• No limits - Choose your wheels (26" or 700c)
• Perfect size - Every build is custom
• More efficient ride - We use a stiffener tube
• Built to ISO standards - Serviceable anywhere
• Hand crafted in Seattle for your unique needs
• Your stoker will appreciate more room
• Enjoy the comfort of a light weight steel frame
• Anything else....Just ask!
Full bike from $6,500
Travel, Gravel, Touring, Sport .... Pick your passion! Read More...
Now offered in our exclusive e-ready frame option for only $250 extra A great all around custom tandem for an incredible price!
At Rodriguez, every tandem is custom built for the riders at no extra charge. This means that we can build your Rodriguez custom frame for light duty weekend rides, or for heavy duty loaded touring. Wheel size is your choice, as is brake type and paint. If you want extra braze-ons for water bottles, a custom kick stand mount, or anything else, just let us know. Every bike is built one at a time, so it's no problem. Not only that, but your tandem will be tailored to fit you both perfectly. Parts will wear out, but the frame should be forever. Why not get it just like you want the first time?
Our direct internal design means that the frame has a 'stiffener' tube running the distance between the rear bottom bracket and the head tube. This makes the tandem harder to build, but it will perform better in all situations.
I think you'll find that Rodriguez tandems are the best value on the market today. Go ahead and look around, you won't find a better custom tandem anywhere near this price. Now you can afford a custom tandem built by the most experienced professionals in the industry.
Custom Classic Tandem Models - Start an order - Wait Time: 8-9 weeks
Paint Options. Decal Options:
With a Rodriguez, you can get a custom look for less. All Rodriguez bicycles come in your choice of 16 standard paint colors or for a few $$ extra you can choose from dozens of our snazzy colors in stock. We have four different styles of decals to choose from in . If you have a special paint design in mind, just let us know the design, and we'll quote it for you.
Let 'er Fly! with the Rodriguez travel upgrade on any Classic Custom steel tandem for $2,550 or ($5,099 ti frame) .
Experience:
Available in
Rohloff version
At Rodriguez Biycles, we have over years of designing, building and riding tandems behind us. Most people don't realize that we're about the oldest tandem manufacturers still building our tandems in the U.S. This gives us a broad range of experience and enables us to create the perfect tandem for you. I've always said that when you buy a bike, you're also buying a relationship with the shop as well as the people who built your bike. This is especially true with tandems.
Save $$$ on Maintenance
We go to great lengths to incorporate components that will be reliable, durable and suited for tandem use. This means that the 'latest and greatest' (according to slick advertising campaigns anyway) fall by the wayside sometimes to make way for the 'tried and true'. This is all an effort to prevent chaos for you down the road. You'll notice for instance, that Rodriguez tandems are spec'd with 9-sp drive trains, as well as our Trillium Big Squeeze™ tandem brakes. These 'tried and true' components can potentially save the owner hundreds each year in maintenance. When you take a personalized test ride with us, you'll see why Rodriguez tandems have stood the test of time!
